# `braindump/v1` — braindump/<ts>.md — director brain dump

<!-- AUTOGENERATED from `Glorbo.FileSpec.BraindumpMd` by
     `mix glorbo.docs.file_formats`. Do not edit by hand;
     regen after changing the spec module. -->

Director's brain-dump entries captured via the dedicated UI.
Filename is typically `YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS.md` or a slugified
title. Body is free-form markdown — bullets, thoughts, links,
screenshots referenced by path.

## Frontmatter schema

**Required:** `kind`, `created_at`

**Optional:** `title`, `tags`, `author`


## Canonical key order

When the formatter rewrites this file, keys appear in this order:

`kind`, `created_at`, `author`, `title`, `tags`

Unknown keys fall after the known block, sorted alphabetically.

## Examples

```markdown
---
kind: braindump/v1
created_at: 2026-04-21T10:30:00Z
title: Rename tweaks drawer? sidebar is getting crowded
author: director
tags: [ui, sidebar, m6]
---
The sidebar has ten rows now. Maybe fold Brain dump into a
top-bar shortcut like /chat has.
```
